details: Browser-side traffic-cloaking script (Adspect integration) used to hide phishing or malvertising content from scanners. It contains no library functionality. It queries rpc.adspect.net and loads remote content through attacker proxies (protectionupdated.xyz, association-google.xyz, zahlungsuberprufung.online, appprotector.online) and api.allorigins.win into a hidden container. Part of the brightlineelectr / signals-embed family, which shares Adspect stream IDs afbf8094-51fb-45f5-a2f8-7b2a14b352c0 and fbaf1202-e5ff-4b06-9c94-9692d823b8cd. Reported to npm on 2026-11-25 and replaced with a security holding package (0.0.1-security) on 2026-11-25.
